newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale remains in limbo.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale remains in limbo.

text.p: The auction of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), scheduled for 1000 local/0900 EDT/1300 GMT, remained suspended, a spokeswoman for the Rio de Janeiro bolsa said.
The spokeswoman said it was unclear when the sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares would kick off.
"We are waiting for the National Development Bank to authorize the start of the auction," she said.
What was due to have been Latin America's largest privatization to date was due to have begun Tuesday but was postponed until Wednesday, at the earliest, due to a flood of court injunctions.
The government hoped to lodge what newspapers were calling a "super appeal" against the injunctions with a higher court in Brasilia and it remained unclear when that court might rule.
